one_line_description: Pylon is a customer support platform that uses AI agents to automate repetitive tasks, allowing humans to focus on high-value tasks.
auth_notes: Pylon uses the OIDC standard for authentication and has a built-in authentication system that is tightly integrated with ZITADEL for user management and access control.

evidence.quote_snippet: Pylon lets humans and agents collaborate on customer work—investigating, resolving, and acting on every signal.
Pylon’s API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.
Pylon is the only agentic support platform purpose-built for B2B.
